properties.description: Class invariants over the trolley (4c35490abf0cefdf) and cogito (989598dd02246a81) designs exported from flo2.io at 0.89.0, and the five proof-trial fixtures: every objection aimed at a step is listed on the step with its standing, the step reads defeated/contested/answered accordingly, the read-back of its conclusion walks the objection and lists the step under steps_objected, and the conclusion is never refuted by it; every claim that holds names exactly the minimal lines its holding steps give it (read-back, foundations, proof status); every holding `all` step holds under exactly the minimal combinations of its premises' lines. Plus the measured shapes: the trolley's two step objections, the cogito syllogism step defeated then reinstated then contested, Driver under any one of five principles, the Thomson-2008 step inheriting only its own principle, an objection inside one line contesting a claim another line holds outside it, and rival positions with mutual objections both contested.
properties.findings: 8 of 8 pass on the branch (cargo test -p reflow2-core --no-default-features --test in_memory an_argument_reads). On main 50af571 7 of 8 failed (the trolley steps read holds with no objections; Driver named one principle; the Thomson-2008 step inherited Foot's principle; the one-line objection refuted); the rival-positions test passed there, pinning the existing recipe the skill teaches.
properties.name: An argument reads step objections and every line's assumptions (8 core tests)
